## Selected projects

### Gamification & Commercial Success in Educational Math Apps

**Mathematics bachelor's thesis · R · Statistical analysis**

Which gamification features are associated with app downloads?

An exploratory analysis of 200 educational mathematics apps,
using multiple linear regression, HC3 robust standard errors
and sensitivity analyses.

**Demonstrates:** data preparation, statistical modelling,
diagnostics and interpretation.

### Climate Trends in Spain and Europe

**PKF Attest project · End-to-end analysis · Published company report**

Analysed temperature and precipitation trends across Spain
and Europe, from source data through to short and long
client reports. The report was subsequently published by
PKF Attest.

**Demonstrates:** analysis of real-world data, interpretation
of trends and communication of findings.

### Mathematical Flexibility in Primary Education

**Primary Education bachelor's thesis · Mixed methods · JASP**

Designed a five-session classroom study combining written
assessments, structured observation and qualitative records.
The follow-up sample comprised 15 participants within a
class of 22.

**Demonstrates:** research design, structured data collection,
statistical analysis and critical evaluation of measurement.

Portfolio case study under review.
